provenance.construction: Two-block group algebra code over the affine group Aff(F_19) = Z19 x| Z18 (order 342, y x y^-1 = x^2): HX = [L[a] L[b]], HZ = [R[b] R[a]] with element-index supports a=[43, 79, 102, 184, 219, 275], b=[43, 135, 168, 206, 314, 335] in the left/right regular representation; n = 2|G| = 684, max check weight 12.
provenance.notes: Found by a randomized search over 2BGA codes on affine groups and their metacyclic subgroups, gated by an escalating distance ladder. The reported d is the lowest weight found over multi-seed randomized information-set searches at 200k, 2M and 20M iterations; the recorded per-side witnesses come from the 20M pass and were re-verified to commute with the opposite check matrix and to lie outside the stabilizer.
